subtopics.label: COVID-19 Epidemiology, Clinical Outcomes, and Variants
subtopics.description: Research characterizing SARS-CoV-2 transmission dynamics, clinical severity, hospitalization outcomes, variant-specific disease burden, and population-level epidemiological patterns across diverse geographic settings including Qatar, New York City, and global cohorts.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level epidemiology of SARS-CoV-2 transmission, disease severity, hospitalization, and variant burden across global cohorts.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Vaccines, Immunity, and Reinfection Protection
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating mRNA and other COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness, waning immunity, booster doses, hybrid immunity, breakthrough infections, and natural infection protection against SARS-CoV-2 variants including Omicron, primarily from Qatar's national cohort and other large populations.
subtopics.short_description: Vaccine effectiveness, waning immunity, booster doses, and hybrid immunity against SARS-CoV-2 variants in large national cohorts.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Impact on Health Systems and Care Delivery
subtopics.description: Research examining how the COVID-19 pandemic disrupted healthcare delivery, surgical operations, clinical trials, mental health services, and public health programs, including adaptations such as telehealth expansion, hospital surge planning, and infection control protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of COVID-19 on healthcare delivery, surgical operations, mental health services, and adaptations including telehealth expansion.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Mental Health and Psychosocial Impacts
subtopics.description: Studies investigating psychological distress, loneliness, anxiety, depression, and mental health service utilization among diverse populations during the COVID-19 pandemic, including healthcare workers, college students, older adults, children, and specific community groups.
subtopics.short_description: Psychological distress, anxiety, depression, and mental health service use among diverse populations during the COVID-19 pandemic.

subtopics.label: Long COVID and Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2
subtopics.description: Research characterizing the prevalence, risk factors, symptoms, and functional impacts of post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC/Long COVID), including racial and ethnic disparities, environmental risk factors, and treatment effects on long COVID outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, symptoms, and functional impacts of post-acute SARS-CoV-2 sequelae across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Health Disparities, Social Determinants of Health, and Health Equity
subtopics.description: Population-level research examining how social determinants of health (race/ethnicity, socioeconomic status, neighborhood conditions, insurance coverage) drive disparities in disease outcomes, healthcare access, and mortality across diverse U.S. and international populations.
subtopics.short_description: How race, socioeconomic status, and neighborhood conditions drive disparities in disease outcomes, access, and mortality.

subtopics.label: Infectious Disease Epidemiology and Control in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies on the burden, transmission, prevention, and treatment of infectious diseases including HIV, tuberculosis, hepatitis, schistosomiasis, malaria, and sexually transmitted infections in low- and middle-income countries across sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America.
subtopics.short_description: Burden, transmission, prevention, and treatment of HIV, TB, malaria, and other infectious diseases in low- and middle-income countries.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Comorbidities and Cardiovascular Disease in Sub-Saharan Africa
subtopics.description: Research from Tanzania and other sub-Saharan African settings examining cardiovascular complications, renal disease, blood pressure, metabolic disorders, and mortality among people living with HIV, including the effects of antiretroviral therapy on cardiometabolic outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular, renal, and metabolic complications among people living with HIV in sub-Saharan Africa, including antiretroviral therapy effects.

subtopics.label: Non-Communicable Disease Burden and Management in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and intervention research on diabetes, hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and related non-communicable diseases in low- and middle-income country settings including Haiti, Qatar, Tanzania, Jordan, Oman, and India, with emphasis on community-based management and mathematical modeling of disease burden.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology and community-based management of diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease in low- and middle-income country settings.

subtopics.label: Sexually Transmitted Infection Epidemiology and Mathematical Modeling
subtopics.description: Systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and mathematical modeling studies characterizing the global and regional epidemiology of herpes simplex virus types 1 and 2, gonorrhea, chlamydia, syphilis, and HIV, including transmission dynamics, intervention impact, and economic burden particularly in MENA, sub-Saharan Africa, and other regions.
subtopics.short_description: Global and regional burden of herpes, gonorrhea, chlamydia, syphilis, and HIV using systematic reviews and transmission modeling.

subtopics.label: Viral Hepatitis Epidemiology, Screening, and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on the epidemiology, screening, treatment, and elimination of hepatitis B, C, and D infections across diverse populations including people who inject drugs, pregnant women, and populations in the Middle East, North Africa, and the United States, with emphasis on access to care and treatment outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology, screening, treatment, and elimination of hepatitis B, C, and D across high-risk and underserved populations worldwide.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use, Substance Use Policy, and Harm Reduction
subtopics.description: Studies examining opioid prescribing policies, overdose prevention, naloxone distribution, medication for opioid use disorder, harm reduction programs including syringe service programs, and the economic burden of drug overdose in the United States, with attention to policy effectiveness and health equity.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing policy, naloxone distribution, medication-assisted treatment, and syringe service programs with a focus on health equity.

subtopics.label: Maternal, Perinatal, and Reproductive Health
subtopics.description: Research on maternal morbidity and mortality, perinatal outcomes, prenatal substance use policies, reproductive health disparities, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and interventions to improve maternal and newborn health across diverse populations in the United States and low- and middle-income countries.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal morbidity, perinatal outcomes, reproductive health disparities, and interventions for mothers and newborns in diverse settings.

subtopics.label: Emergency Care, Trauma, and Surgical Capacity in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Studies on traumatic spinal injuries, burn care, emergency medical systems, surgical capacity building, and trauma outcomes in low- and middle-income country settings particularly in East Africa, Pakistan, and other resource-limited environments, including telemedicine and training innovations.
subtopics.display_name: Emergency Care & Surgical Capacity in LMICs
subtopics.short_description: Trauma outcomes, burn care, emergency medical systems, and surgical capacity building in resource-limited settings across East Africa and Asia.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment, Elder Abuse Prevention, and Aging Populations
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, risk factors, detection, and community response to elder mistreatment including physical abuse, financial exploitation, and caregiver neglect, with studies examining multidisciplinary team approaches, screening tools, and the impact of COVID-19 on elder abuse rates.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, screening, and multidisciplinary responses to elder abuse, financial exploitation, and caregiver neglect.

subtopics.label: Malaria Parasite Biology, Drug Resistance, and Novel Therapeutics
subtopics.description: Research on Plasmodium falciparum and vivax biology, mechanisms of antimalarial drug resistance, and development of novel therapeutic agents including proteasome inhibitors and epigenetic targets.
subtopics.short_description: Plasmodium biology, mechanisms of antimalarial resistance, and development of proteasome inhibitors and epigenetic therapeutic targets.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Diagnostics, Testing Methods, and Surveillance
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating RT-PCR, rapid antigen, serological, and molecular assays for SARS-CoV-2 detection, including variant genotyping, wastewater surveillance, and diagnostic performance comparisons.
subtopics.short_description: Performance of RT-PCR, rapid antigen, and serological assays for SARS-CoV-2, including wastewater surveillance and variant genotyping.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Treatment, Therapeutics, and Clinical Management
subtopics.description: Research on pharmacological treatments for COVID-19 including monoclonal antibodies, antivirals, repurposed drugs, and clinical management strategies across disease severity levels.
subtopics.short_description: Monoclonal antibodies, antivirals, and repurposed drugs for COVID-19 treatment across disease severity levels.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 in Pediatric Populations and Children's Health During the Pandemic
subtopics.description: Studies examining SARS-CoV-2 infection presentation, severity, hospitalization, and immune responses in children and adolescents, including Omicron wave impacts and pandemic effects on pediatric care.
subtopics.short_description: SARS-CoV-2 severity, hospitalization, and immune responses in children and adolescents, including Omicron wave and pandemic care impacts.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Population Immunity, Mathematical Modeling, and Epidemiological Interventions
subtopics.description: Mathematical and epidemiological modeling of SARS-CoV-2 transmission, herd immunity, reinfection dynamics, non-pharmaceutical interventions, and vaccination prioritization strategies.
subtopics.short_description: Mathematical modeling of SARS-CoV-2 transmission, herd immunity, reinfection dynamics, and vaccination prioritization strategies.

subtopics.label: Suicide Epidemiology, Risk Factors, and Prevention Across Populations
subtopics.description: Epidemiological studies of suicidal ideation, attempts, and deaths across demographic groups, including geographic variation, social determinants, adolescent trajectories, and prevention interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level patterns of suicidal ideation, attempts, and deaths across demographic groups, with social determinants and prevention strategies.

subtopics.label: Antimicrobial Resistance, Carbapenem-Resistant Organisms, and Infection Control
subtopics.description: Studies on detection, epidemiology, and management of carbapenem-resistant Enterobacterales, multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacteria, and antimicrobial resistance surveillance in clinical and environmental settings.
subtopics.short_description: Epidemiology and management of carbapenem-resistant organisms and multidrug-resistant gram-negative bacteria in clinical and environmental settings.

subtopics.label: Tuberculosis Diagnosis, Treatment, and Epidemiology
subtopics.description: Research on TB diagnosis including novel assays and drug resistance testing, treatment regimens for drug-sensitive and drug-resistant TB, and epidemiological modeling of TB burden and co-morbidities.
subtopics.short_description: Novel TB diagnostics, drug-resistance testing, treatment regimens, and epidemiological modeling of TB burden and comorbidities.

subtopics.label: Non-Communicable Disease Epidemiology and Health Research in Qatar and the Gulf Region
subtopics.description: Studies examining diabetes, hypertension, obesity, mental health, and other NCDs in Qatar and Gulf Cooperation Council countries, including population-based surveys, risk factor analyses, and health system capacity.
subtopics.display_name: NCD Epidemiology in Qatar & the Gulf
subtopics.short_description: Diabetes, hypertension, obesity, and mental health burden in Qatar and Gulf Cooperation Council countries via population-based surveys.

subtopics.label: Cardiovascular Disease Burden and Risk Factors in Low-Income Settings, Particularly Haiti
subtopics.description: Population-based studies of cardiovascular disease prevalence, risk factors (hypertension, diabetes, diet, environmental exposures), and management in low-income countries with a focus on Haiti and sub-Saharan Africa.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence and risk factors for cardiovascular disease in Haiti and sub-Saharan Africa, including hypertension, diet, and environmental exposures.

subtopics.label: Heat-Related Illness, Climate Change, and Environmental Health Impacts
subtopics.description: Research on health impacts of extreme heat events and natural disasters, including heat stroke biomarkers, community interventions, cardiovascular and sleep effects, and climate-related health equity.
subtopics.short_description: Health consequences of extreme heat and natural disasters, including cardiovascular effects, community interventions, and climate-related health equity.

subtopics.label: Perinatal HIV Transmission, Broadly Neutralizing Antibodies, and Infant Immunization
subtopics.description: Studies on maternal-to-child HIV transmission mechanisms, the role of broadly neutralizing antibodies in preventing perinatal and breastmilk transmission, and development of passive and active HIV immunization strategies for infants.
subtopics.short_description: Maternal-to-child HIV transmission, broadly neutralizing antibodies, and passive and active immunization strategies for infants.

subtopics.label: Reproductive Health Policy, Abortion Access, and Contraceptive Autonomy
subtopics.description: Research on abortion access, stigma, and policy including crowdfunding, community-level stigma interventions, and reproductive justice frameworks, as well as contraceptive autonomy and family planning in diverse settings.
subtopics.short_description: Abortion access, stigma reduction, reproductive justice frameworks, and contraceptive autonomy across diverse policy environments.

subtopics.label: Home Health Aides, Long-Term Care Workforce, and Nursing Home Quality
subtopics.description: Studies examining the health, working conditions, and disaster preparedness of home health aides and long-term care workers, as well as quality, staffing, and outcomes in nursing homes.
subtopics.display_name: Long-Term Care Workforce & Nursing Home Quality
subtopics.short_description: Working conditions, disaster preparedness, and health of home health aides, alongside staffing and quality outcomes in nursing homes.

subtopics.label: Cancer Screening, Survivorship, and Disparities in Access and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on cancer screening uptake, survivorship prevalence and outcomes, and disparities by race, ethnicity, language, and socioeconomic status, including interventions to improve equitable access.
subtopics.short_description: Disparities in cancer screening uptake and survivorship outcomes by race, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status, with equity-focused interventions.
